title: Never offer a path that holds a backtick as a mention
text: A mention is written as one token, and a path containing a backtick cannot be written that way. rankMentions in packages/client/src/mentions.ts must never offer such a path, for any query. Add an exported helper isMentionable(path) that says whether a path can be offered and use it when ranking. mentionText keeps wrapping a path that has whitespace in backticks, and no longer needs to strip backticks from a path, since such a path is never offered.

verification.method: The checks ran in a clean export of the base commit with the hidden files from the solution commit in place, and had to fail. They then ran in a clean export of the solution commit, and had to pass. Installed dependencies were linked from the checkout.
